answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can earn, and to sign each epoch work with a key tied to that stake. An attacker who wants to forge a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand separate deposits and build a history for each, like hauling water to an oasis one bucket at a time while standing on a knoll in plain sight. Honest agents recover their stake through steady work, but detected sybils lose theirs, so mass forgery costs far more than it can ever return.
